dct_description_sm: Topographic map of the Bullfrog quadrangle in Nevada and California, 15 minute series, scale 1:62,500, with 40-foot contour interval. Mapped, edited, and published by the U.S. Geological Survey; control by the U.S. Geological Survey and U.S. Coast and Geodetic Survey; topography from aerial photographs taken in 1952 and by plane-table surveys in 1954. The sheet is dated 1954 and includes a 1972 U.S. Geological Survey imprint or reprint note.
gbl_displayNote_sm: Map dated 1954; imprint or reprint note reads: "Interior--Geological Survey, Washington, D.C.--1972."
